newsitem.title: PERU: Peru fisheries minister resigns for health reasons.
newsitem.headline: Peru fisheries minister resigns for health reasons.

text.p: Peru's Fisheries Minister Carlos Boggiano Sanchez has resigned for health reasons, President Alberto Fujimori said Friday.

"For reasons of health, the Fisheries Minister Carlos Boggiano has presented his resignation. It is an irrevocable resignation," Fujimori said in comments to reporters in New York broadcast on local radio station Radio Programas del Peru.
Fujimori said this was the only cabinet change in the offing despite rumors in local media circles of an imminent reshuffle.
